breaks.quote: He tried out his opening line on his morning customers.
breaks.why: This is a built action the person did after the session, staged to show progress, with no record behind it, so the reader is told something the writer cannot vouch for.
A feeling he did not name is stated as fact instead of as the coach's earned hunch, so the reader cannot tell what he actually said or felt.
This extra scene detail answers no question the reader would ask and looks built only to add colour.
